profiles.name: Cessna 172M (1974)
profiles.notes:
Operator identifies C-FFCT as C172M: https://compassflying.com/fleet/
CCAR mirror snapshot 2026-06-30: C172M, serial 17262961, manufactured 1974: https://www.regosearch.com/aircraft/ca/FFCT
Performance is a 1974 stock-aircraft REFERENCE from the AAFC N9850V scan, not FFCT's confirmed POH. Check FFCT's actual manual, propeller and STCs. Empty weight/moment and tank option are not known; no GFJE W&B values copied.

takeoff.conditions: 1974 reference only, not FFCT-confirmed; hard surface, flaps up; PA 0-7500 ft, headwind 0-20 kt; warm correction +10% per 25 F above ISA; dry grass adds 7% of total distance to BOTH distances; no tailwind rule.

landing.conditions: 1974 reference only, not FFCT-confirmed; 2300 lb table; standard-day temperature only; 40-degree flaps, power off; approach IAS 70 MPH; headwind -10% per 5 kt; dry grass adds 20% of total distance to BOTH distances.

cruise.conditions: 1974 SKYHAWK reference, not FFCT-confirmed; 2300 lb, standard-day temperature, lean mixture; McCauley 1C160/DTM7553 or CTM7553; normal cruise <=75% BHP. Standard Model 172 speeds are 1-3 MPH lower than this table.
